run_profiler_training: run the profiler to train BERT on GLUE MRPC with CPU/GPU/TPU profiling support
create_profile_kwargs: create ProfileKwargs with record_shapes, profile_memory, with_flops, and output_trace_dir options
build_accelerator_with_profile: build an Accelerator instance configured with ProfileKwargs for torch profiling

profile_training_loop: profile the training loop using accelerator.profile() context manager and print key_averages
